items.q: Walter Winchell and myself... We go around and do 52nd Street, sit around and talk

ctx.x: there -- and Jack Robbins. you'd go down to (inaudible) Cafe Society or --

We always wound up down at the Cafe Society -- all down that way. And sometimes when Walter (inaudible), it would be like Joe Glaser, Jack Robbins, Walter Winchell and myself. Now Jack would come -- and it was Jack (inaudible) Glaser. (chuckles) Jack would come with these two fine chicks on his arm, you know. Jack Robbins was a sporty, (inaudible). Come with these two fine chicks on his arm. And we go around and do 52nd Street, sit around and talk, watch (inaudible), you know. And that summer, Joe Glaser called…
